ACTF.name: Account Not Found
ACTF.definition: Account of the cardholder or the customer is not found.

AMLV.name: AML Validation
AMLV.definition: Error on AML (Anti Money Laundering) validation.

CRDR.name: Card Error
CRDR.definition: Card error, for instance invalid ARQC (Authorisation ReQuest Cryptogram).

CRDF.name: Card Verification Failed
CRDF.definition: Identification of the card is invalid.

CSHE.name: Cashback Amount Exceeded
CSHE.definition: Cashback amount is higher than permitted.

ACTC.name: Closed Account
ACTC.definition: Account is no more usable for the transaction.

CTVG.name: Cutover In Process
CTVG.definition: Cutover is in progress, transaction could not be processed.

FEES.name: Disputed Fees
FEES.definition: Transaction fees are disputed by the issuer.

TXNL.name: Exceeded Transaction Life Cycle
TXNL.definition: Validity period of the transaction is exceeded.

FMTR.name: Format Error
FMTR.definition: Invalid format of the message or its content.

AMTI.name: Invalid Amount
AMTI.definition: Requested amount is outside the card limits, or the currency is invalid.

CHDI.name: Invalid Cardholder Identification
CHDI.definition: Identification of the cardholder or the customer does not match.

CRDI.name: Invalid Card Number
CRDI.definition: Identification of the card is invalid.

CTFV.name: Invalid Certificate
CTFV.definition: Digital certificate cannot be authenticated, is expired or revoked.

NPRA.name: Not Permitted To Acceptor
NPRA.definition: Process not permitted to the acceptor (for example fall back).

LBLU.name: No Liability Accepted
LBLU.definition: Transaction is processed, but liability is not accepted.

LBLA.name: Liability Accepted
LBLA.definition: Transaction is processed and liability is accepted.

ISSU.name: Issuer Unavailable
ISSU.definition: Transaction could not be processed as Issuer is unavailable.

ISST.name: Issuer Time Out
ISST.definition: Transaction could not be processed as Issuer times out.

ISSO.name: Issuer Signed Off
ISSO.definition: Transaction could not be processed as Issuer is signed off.

DATI.name: Invalid Transaction Date Time
DATI.definition: Date time of the transaction is invalid.

TKID.name: Invalid Token Identification
TKID.definition: Identification of the token provider or the token requestor is invalid.

TKKO.name: Invalid Token
TKKO.definition: Token cannot be used to surrogate a PAN (Primary Account Number).

NPRC.name: Not Permitted To Cardholder
NPRC.definition: Transaction not permitted to the cardholder or the customer.

OFFL.name: Off Line Process
OFFL.definition: Transaction has been processed offline by the terminal.

ONLP.name: Off Line Process After Referral
ONLP.definition: Transaction has been processed offline after referral.

TXNM.name: Original Does Not Match
TXNM.definition: Original is found, but transaction does not match.

AMTL.name: Payment Amount Limit
AMTL.definition: Amount of payment transactions exceeds card limit.

NMBL.name: Payment Number Limit
NMBL.definition: Number of payment transactions exceeds card limit.

PINC.name: PIN Change Required
PINC.definition: Cardholder must change the PIN to be able to perform the transaction.

PIND.name: PIN Data Required
PIND.definition: Additional information are required to verify the PIN.

PINS.name: PIN Security Error
PINS.definition: PIN length or PIN key is invalid.

PINX.name: PIN Tries Exceeded
PINX.definition: Last attempt of the PIN verification fails.

QMAX.name: Queue Maximum Exceeded
QMAX.definition: Store and forward queue maximum exceeded.

CRDT.name: Restricted Card
CRDT.definition: Requested service not allowed by the card.

SECV.name: Security Violation
SECV.definition: Security violation, for instance invalid ARPC (Authorisation ResPonse Cryptogram).

CRDW.name: Wrong Card
CRDW.definition: Other card used for the original transaction.

NMBW.name: Withdrawal Number Limit
NMBW.definition: Number of withdrawal transactions exceeds card limit.

AMTW.name: Withdrawal Amount Limit
AMTW.definition: Amount of withdrawal transactions exceeds card limit.

UNBC.name: Unacceptable Currency
UNBC.definition: Currency is unacceptable for the Issuer or the processor.

UNBO.name: Unable To Go On Line
UNBO.definition: Transaction cannot be processed online by the terminal.

ORGF.name: Unable To Find Original
ORGF.definition: Transaction could not be processed as original is not found.

TXND.name: Transaction Duplicate
TXND.definition: Transaction identification already used for another transaction.

TXNU.name: Transaction Did Not Complete
TXNU.definition: Transaction did not complete at the terminal.

FRDS.name: Suspected Fraud
FRDS.definition: Fraudulent transaction is suspected by the issuer or the processor.

CNTC.name: Suspected Counterfeit Card
CNTC.definition: Counterfeit card suspected by the issuer or the processor.

ACKO.name: Acknowledgement Only
ACKO.definition: Message is acknowledged only without processing the service, for instance the reconciliation is not performed, acknowledged only.
